api.name: API Structures sanitaires
api.description:
Version 1 : consultation, recherche et pagination d'un référentiel fictif de structures sanitaires.

Accès via la gateway Gravitee : `http://localhost:8082/sante/structures/v1` avec l'en-tête `X-Gravitee-Api-Key`.

Toutes les erreurs du backend suivent le format `ErrorResponse` (status, code, message, details).

pages.name: Swagger
pages.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: API Structures sanitaires
  version: 1.0.0
  description: 'Version 1 : consultation, recherche et pagination d''un référentiel
    fictif de structures sanitaires.


    Accès via la gateway Gravitee : `http://localhost:8082/sante/structures/v1` avec
    l''en-tête `X-Gravitee-Api-Key`.


    Toutes les erreurs du backend suivent le format `ErrorResponse` (status, code,
    message, details).'
  contact:
    name: SI Groupe 2 — IBAM 2026
paths:
  /structures:
    get:
      summary: Lister les structures (paginé)
      operationId: list_structures_api_v1_structures_get
      parameters:
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Numéro de page, à partir de 1
          default: 1
          title: Page
        description: Numéro de page, à partir de 1
      - name: size
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          maximum: 100
          minimum: 1
          description: Nombre d'éléments par page (1 à 100)
          default: 10
          title: Size
        description: Nombre d'éléments par page (1 à 100)
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageV1'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
  /structures/search:
    get:
      summary: Rechercher des structures (paginé)
      description: Au moins un critère est obligatoire. `q` cherche dans le nom et
        le code.
      operationId: search_structures_api_v1_structures_search_get
      parameters:
      - name: q
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            minLength: 2
            maxLength: 100
          - type: 'null'
          description: Texte recherché dans le nom ou le code
          title: Q
        description: Texte recherché dans le nom ou le code
      - name: type
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/TypeStructure'
          - type: 'null'
          description: Type de structure
          title: Type
        description: Type de structure
      - name: region
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            maxLength: 60
          - type: 'null'
          description: Région (insensible à la casse)
          title: Region
        description: Région (insensible à la casse)
      - name: ville
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          anyOf:
          - type: string
            maxLength: 80
          - type: 'null'
          description: Ville (insensible à la casse)
          title: Ville
        description: Ville (insensible à la casse)
      - name: page
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          default: 1
          title: Page
      - name: size
        in: query
        required: false
        schema:
          type: integer
          maximum: 100
          minimum: 1
          default: 10
          title: Size
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/PageV1'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
  /structures/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Obtenir le détail d'une structure
      operationId: get_structure_api_v1_structures__id__get
      parameters:
      - name: id
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Identifiant technique de la structure
          title: Id
        description: Identifiant technique de la structure
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful Response
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/StructureV1'
        '404':
          description: Structure inexistante (STRUCTURE_NOT_FOUND)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '400':
          description: Paramètres invalides (VALIDATION_ERROR, MISSING_CRITERIA)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '503':
          description: Base de données indisponible (DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          description: Erreur interne (INTERNAL_ERROR)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Clé d'API absente, invalide ou souscription fermée (renvoyé
            par la gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Unauthorized
                http_status_code: 401
        '429':
          description: Limite de requêtes ou quota du plan dépassé (renvoyé par la
            gateway Gravitee)
          content:
            application/json:
              example:
                message: Rate limit exceeded ! You reach the limit of 5 requests per
                  10 seconds
                http_status_code: 429
      tags:
      - Structures sanitaires
      security:
      - ApiKeyGravitee: []
components:
  schemas:
    ErrorDetail:
      properties:
        champ:
          type: string
          title: Champ
          examples:
          - size
        message:
          type: string
          title: Message
          examples:
          - Input should be less than or equal to 100
      type: object
      required:
      - champ
      - message
      title: ErrorDetail
    ErrorResponse:
      properties:
        status:
          type: integer
          title: Status
          examples:
          - 404
        code:
          type: string
          title: Code
          examples:
          - STRUCTURE_NOT_FOUND
        message:
          type: string
          title: Message
          examples:
          - Aucune structure avec l'id 999
        details:
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorDetail'
          type: array
          title: Details
          default: []
      type: object
      required:
      - status
      - code
      - message
      title: ErrorResponse
    PageV1:
      properties:
        page:
          type: integer
          title: Page
          examples:
          - 1
        size:
          type: integer
          title: Size
          examples:
          - 10
        total:
          type: integer
          title: Total
          examples:
          - 40
        pages:
          type: integer
          title: Pages
          examples:
          - 4
        items:
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/StructureV1'
          type: array
          title: Items
      type: object
      required:
      - page
      - size
      - total
      - pages
      - items
      title: PageV1
    StructureV1:
      properties:
        id:
          type: integer
          title: Id
          examples:
          - 1
        code:
          type: string
          title: Code
          examples:
          - CHU-CEN-001
        nom:
          type: string
          title: Nom
          examples:
          - CHU Fictif de Ouagadougou Nord
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/TypeStructure'
        region:
          type: string
          title: Region
          examples:
          - Centre
        ville:
          type: string
          title: Ville
          examples:
          - Ouagadougou
      type: object
      required:
      - id
      - code
      - nom
      - type
      - region
      - ville
      title: StructureV1
    TypeStructure:
      type: string
      enum:
      - CHU
      - CHR
      - CMA
      - CSPS
      - CLINIQUE
      title: TypeStructure
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyGravitee:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Gravitee-Api-Key
servers:
- url: http://structures-api:8000/api/v1
  description: Backend (réseau Docker, cible de la gateway)
